intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.11.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 10.98 MB binary -42.2% vs v1.1.0, 57.7 KB gzip shell, 31.75ms pinned cold boot -6.7%, 16.45 MB RSS -4.5%, Studio Economy & Funnel Dry-Run Simulator, 1-Click Launch Autopilot, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 official MCP tools, 26/26 fuzz, and 4,528 req/s 16w pinned with 4.21ms p95), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.9.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with Swarm Bottleneck Heat Bar & 1-Click Copy Blocker, Inline Worktree Diff Peek & CWE-22/CWE-59 confinement, Board Quick-Filters & Wave Digest, #seq Quote-Reply, native zlib.crc32 ETag, and 91.9 KiB gz / 71.06 MB --jitless RSS / 21.48ms max tail -12.9% / 28/28 fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.21.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 9.39 MB binary -41.3% vs v0.10.0, 9.27ms boot, 19.32 MB RSS -2.0%, 4,818.3 req/s +23.0%, 4.34ms p95 -21.7%, Playbook Dry-Run Preview with Reversible via .history/ safety badge, 1-Click Verified Playbook Pack Export/Import .ergon-playbook.json + SHA-256, Multi-Run Summary Pack .md/.html, Citation Freshness Gate, Verified Client Handoff .html, and 29/29 fuzz).
